verdict.rationale: Google Drive has a documented public REST API (v3). The reference docs cover files, permissions and changes, and guides cover uploads (simple, multipart, resumable), search/list, custom properties, sharing permissions, push notifications and OAuth scopes. A machine-readable discovery document is also published at googleapis.com, which suits programmatic and agent use. Probes found no llms.txt or OpenAPI file at the developers.google.com root, but the discovery doc covers the machine-readable role, so this is a minor gap for AI-native use. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration explicitly tied to driving the API (community rclone mentions don't state they use it), an LLM-oriented docs entry point (llms.txt).
